testcase.name: a failed copy is reported and neither the waypoints nor the track are touched
waypoints are detached before the track is deleted, so a failed detach leaves the track in place
a track that is already gone copies nothing and the delete still runs
a failed delete after a successful detach is reported as a failure
the track's path is copied before the track is deleted, as the lat and lng of the points the repository returns
the track goes, its waypoints stay with the link nulled, and other tracks' links are untouched
